findings.title: No Authentication on Any Endpoint — AI Assessment Pipeline Bypass
findings.exploit_chain: POST /api/feature-requests → PATCH /:id {status:voting} → POST /:id/force-approve → approved with zero agent votes, zero credentials
findings.remediation: Add JWT/API-key authentication middleware in app.ts before all route registrations. Define roles (viewer, operator, admin) and enforce role checks on every state-mutation endpoint.

findings.title: Arbitrary File Upload + Public Exfiltration — /etc/passwd Confirmed Live
findings.owasp: A08: Software and Data Integrity Failures
findings.exploit_chain: Upload /etc/passwd with Content-Type: image/jpeg → GET /uploads/<uuid>.jpg → /etc/passwd contents returned; PHP shell upload also confirmed
findings.remediation: Validate file magic bytes (not MIME header) using the 'file-type' package. Store uploads outside web root. Gate /uploads/ behind authentication. Allowlist valid MIME types.

findings.title: No Pagination Limit Cap — Full Dataset Enumeration in One Request
findings.remediation: Clamp limit to Math.min(parsed, 100) in workItems.ts and dashboard.ts. Apply the same cap in dashboardService.getActivity().

findings.title: Ghost Dependency Permanent DoS — Soft-Delete Orphans Dependents
findings.remediation: On soft-delete of a blocker, automatically resolve or remove the dependency. Filter soft-deleted IDs from unresolved_blockers in API responses.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Deny/Approve Sabotage — Terminal State Manipulation
findings.remediation: Resolved by MERGED-C01 (add authentication + operator role). Consider grace-period 'undo deny' window before terminal state is permanent.

findings.title: Fast-Track Override Bypasses Entire Assessment Pod
findings.remediation: Remove or gate the overrideRoute parameter behind an admin-only role. Log fast-track usage to audit trail.

findings.title: Webhook Spoofing — No Signature Verification + No Enum Validation on Intake
findings.owasp: A08: Software and Data Integrity Failures
findings.remediation: Validate X-Zendesk-Webhook-Signature via HMAC-SHA256. Validate type/priority against Object.values(WorkItemType/WorkItemPriority). Require bearer token on automated endpoint.

findings.title: Cascade Auto-Dispatch on Rejection — State Machine Logic Manipulation
findings.remediation: Require operator-role auth for rejection actions. Add validation that auto-dispatch cannot skip required assessment states.

findings.title: No TLS / HTTPS Enforcement
findings.remediation: Terminate TLS at server or reverse proxy. Set HSTS header. Add HTTP→HTTPS redirect.

findings.title: Required Audit Events Not Emitted
findings.remediation: Implement auditLog(event_type, actor_id, resource_id, outcome, timestamp, source_ip). Emit state_transition on every status change.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting on Any Endpoint
findings.remediation: Apply express-rate-limit globally (100 req/min per IP) with stricter limits on mutation endpoints.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Prometheus /metrics Endpoint
findings.remediation: Move /metrics to internal-only port (127.0.0.1:9090) or gate with bearer-token check.

findings.title: Internal Error Messages Forwarded to HTTP Clients
findings.remediation: Replace res.status(500).json({ error: message }) with res.status(500).json({ error: 'Internal server error' }) in all catch blocks.

findings.title: Missing HTTP Security Headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, CORS)
findings.remediation: npm install helmet cors. app.use(helmet()) + app.use(cors({ origin: process.env.ALLOWED_ORIGINS?.split(',') })) before route registrations.

findings.title: Unsandboxed <iframe> in DebugPortalPage
findings.remediation: Add sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-forms" to iframe. Remove allow-same-origin if portal origin differs. Add CSP frame-src directive.

findings.title: Audit Logs Lack Caller Identity and Request Correlation IDs
findings.remediation: Generate UUID requestId per request in middleware. Use AsyncLocalStorage to propagate it. Inject actor_id once auth is implemented.

findings.title: Audit Logs Not Durably Persisted or Tamper-Protected
findings.remediation: Forward logs to CloudWatch Logs, Datadog, or Elasticsearch. Configure 13-month retention. Use append-only/WORM storage.

findings.title: Unused pino Production Dependency — Phantom Attack Surface
findings.remediation: Remove pino from dependencies and run npm install.

findings.title: Soft-Delete Only — No GDPR Erasure Capability
findings.remediation: Implement hardDelete(id) in store and an admin-only DELETE /api/work-items/:id/purge endpoint.

findings.title: Negative Pagination Parameters Cause Unexpected Slice Behavior
findings.remediation: Validate page >= 1 and limit >= 1; return 400 on invalid values.

findings.title: No Length Limits on Free-Text Fields — Memory Inflation Risk
findings.remediation: Enforce max lengths in validation schemas (title: 200 chars, description: 5000 chars).

findings.title: Missing /api/search Endpoint Referenced by Frontend
findings.remediation: Implement endpoint with auth and input sanitization, or remove the frontend reference.
